passages.text: Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name are we come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.
passages.note: Feeling powerless against overwhelming odds; asking for help

passages.text: But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack; for your work will be rewarded.
